name: Joseph R. Saveri
tagline: Top rated Antitrust Litigation attorney in San Francisco, California

about: A pillar of leadership within his legal community with over 30 years of experience, Joseph R. Saveri is renowned for his work in antitrust law, as well as in class actions, complex business disputes, intellectual property law, anticompetitive behavior, and qui tam and whistleblower cases. At the Joseph Saveri Law Firm, LLP, in San Francisco, California, he serves clients throughout the state and nationwide.

Mr. Saveri completed his undergraduate studies with honors at the University of California, Berkeley, graduating with his Bachelor of Arts degree. He went on to attend the University of Virginia School of Law and received his Juris Doctor in 1987, as well as his license to practice law in California. Throughout his illustrious career, Mr. Savieri has consistently worked to move the needle of client care to even greater heights through his practice, emphasizing a tenacious work ethic and expansive legal and practical knowledge. For his many contributions, he has been rated AV Preeminent* through Martindale-Hubbell, the organization’s highest rating, and he has been recognized by The Best Lawyers in America for his work in antitrust litigation and mass tort/class action litigation. Additionally, he is also on the Advisory Board of the American Antitrust Institute.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
